report.summary: Analyzed local_graph function; all docstring claims are verified against the code.

handoff.purpose: Implements local_graph function to extract n-hop neighbourhood around a page.

symbols.name: local_graph
symbols.note: Returns dict with center, depth, nodes, edges, truncated, note.

claims.text: The n-hop neighbourhood around one page, undirected.
claims.why: Function uses both forward and backward links, treating them as undirected.

claims.text: Depth 1 by default because that is the question a reader has ("what is next to this?").
claims.why: Default depth=1 is set in function signature.

claims.text: Bounded and it SAYS when it stopped, rather than presenting a clipped neighbourhood as complete.
claims.why: max_nodes bounds the search; truncated flag and note indicate when bound hit.

observations.what: Function uses sorted(frontier) and sorted(neighbours) to ensure deterministic order.
Truncation check uses len(seen) >= max_nodes, so max_nodes is the maximum number of nodes returned (including center).
Edges are deduplicated by checking key not in edges.
Returned 'depth' is the requested depth, not the actual depth reached.
No handling of missing 'rel' in idx.forward or idx.backward; if rel not in index, seen={rel}, frontier=[rel], and no edges added.
